tagline_en: Build a strong base: talk about your life, your experiences and your plans in longer, clearer sentences.
tagline_ar: هتحكي عن حياتك وتجاربك وخططك بثقة وبجمل أطول وأوضح.
intro_ar: المستوى ده معمول للي خلّص المستوى الأول أو عنده أساسيات الإنجليزي وعايز يبني أساس قوي. في ١٢ أسبوع، نص ساعة كل يوم، هتتعلم ٣٦٠ كلمة جديدة و١٢٠ جملة وأهم قواعد مستوى A2. في الآخر هتقدر تحكي عن سفرياتك وتجاربك، وتقارن بين الأماكن، وتتكلم عن خططك، وتشرح مشكلة وتلاقي لها حل.
can_do: After this level you can describe yourself, your lifestyle and what you are doing these days.
After this level you can tell a story about a trip or something that happened to you.
After this level you can compare places and talk about your plans, arrangements and predictions.
After this level you can talk about your life experiences and share recent news.
After this level you can explain rules, give health advice and talk about problems and solutions.
After this level you can describe people, places, hobbies and how your life has changed.

items.name: Learn English with Bob the Canadian (podcast)

end.title: You Finished Level 2! What Next?
end.intro: Congratulations — in 12 weeks you learned 360 new words, 120 key sentences and the main grammar of A2. Now you can talk about your life, your past, your experiences and your plans. Keep your 30 minutes a day!
next_steps: Start Level 3 (Pre-Intermediate, B1) — don't take a long break.
Listen again to your favourite Level 2 podcast episodes without the transcript. Can you understand most of them?
Listen to one BBC 6 Minute English episode a week and read the transcript after you listen.
Try the British Council B1 listening and reading lessons.
Write 100 words a week in an English diary, using the grammar of this level.
Do the three progress checks again and compare your new scores.
end.tip_ar: لا تنتظر حتى تصبح «مثاليًا» لتتكلم! استخدم جمل هذا المستوى في حياتك اليومية: احكِ لنفسك عن يومك بالإنجليزية، وراجع الجمل الـ١٢٠ مرة كل أسبوع.
